docs.text: Combat Abilities Astral Rebuke Unleash a homing spike that erupts beneath enemies and throws them in the air. Applies Lifted and builds up Astralized . Barrage Sends projectiles hurtling towards a target. Ignite Melee Attacks and Barrage , Shield , and Volatile Anomaly do Fire Damage that applies Burn .
